**Step 1 — Scene:** A mixed meal of cheese pizza, Caesar-style salad, broccoli, and sliced cooked chicken.

**Step 2 — Vessel:** A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 27–28 cm across. Using a 27 cm circular approximation gives an area of **3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Cheese pizza with tomato sauce; romaine lettuce; creamy dressing; croutons; Parmesan shavings; cooked broccoli; and chicken slices. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate.

**Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cheese pizza | 24% | 137 × 1.1 = 151 ml | 0.95 | 143 g | 280 | 400 kcal |
| Romaine lettuce | 30% | 172 × 2.5 = 430 ml | 0.15 | 64 g | 17 | 11 kcal |
| Croutons | 3% | 17 × 1.3 = 22 ml | 0.30 | 7 g | 400 | 28 kcal |
| Parmesan shavings | 1% | 6 × 0.2 = 1.2 ml | 1.0 | 1 g | 420 | 4 kcal |
| Chicken slices | 10% | 57 × 1.4 = 80 ml | 1.0 | 80 g | 165 | 132 kcal |
| Broccoli | 9% | 51 × 2 = 102 ml | 0.60 | 62 g | 35 | 22 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | Coats lettuce* | Approximately 18 ml | 1.0 | 18 g | 500 | 90 kcal |

*Dressing shares the salad footprint, so it adds no separate coverage. Food coverage totals approximately **77%**. Dressing quantity is estimated from the visible coating.*

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **375 g and 687 kcal** is plausible for the visible pizza slice, modest chicken portion, broccoli, and dressed salad. Dressing quantity and pizza thickness are the largest uncertainties.
